h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mirzapur

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mirzapur

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Mirzapur

c: Mirzapur sits where the Vindhya hills meet the Ganga, and its pilgrims, carpet weavers and students give the town a steady daily rhythm. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Mirzapur for schools, colleges, ghats and riverside parks, and residential colonies. We build the machines at our Vasai factory, about 1180 km away, and send them to Uttar Pradesh by road.

A dealer in north India or our own team installs them on site. Mirzapur has very hot summers and a strong monsoon, and the ground varies from river silt to rocky hill slopes. On silt, we grout each machine deep into concrete. On rock, the footing can be shallower but must be level. In both cases, the layout drawing shows each footing and the clear space before we start manufacturing.

items.q: Can outdoor gym equipment be placed near the Ganga?
items.a: Yes, if the site is above the usual flood level. Grout each machine into concrete and check bolts and joints after the monsoon recedes.

items.q: What changes when the site is on a hill slope?
items.a: We cut a level pad for each machine and grout it in. Steps and paths are kept outside each machine's clear space, so no one walks through a moving part.

items.q: How do we start an enquiry?
items.a: Send the site size, photos and the users you expect to sales@funplaysystems.com or call +91 902 830 2266. We reply with a list of machines, a layout and a quote.
